The interaction Lagrangian is \(\mathcal{L} = -\lambda_f \bar{\psi}_f (\upsilon + X) \psi_f\), which gives a fermion mass \(m_f = \lambda_f \upsilon\) and a coupling of \(X\) to \(f\bar{f}\) proportional to \(m_f/\upsilon\). The boson \(X\) has mass \(m_X = 6\,\text{GeV}\). At tree level, the only kinematically allowed two-body decays are \(X \to f\bar{f}\) for fermions with \(2m_f < m_X\).

Approximate fermion masses:
- Top (\(t\)): \(\sim 173\,\text{GeV}\) (not allowed)
- Bottom (\(b\)): \(\sim 4.18\)–\(4.8\,\text{GeV}\) \(\Rightarrow 2m_b > 6\,\text{GeV}\) (not allowed)
- Charm (\(c\)): \(\sim 1.27\,\text{GeV}\) \(\Rightarrow 2m_c \approx 2.54\,\text{GeV} < 6\,\text{GeV}\) (allowed)
- Strange (\(s\)): \(\sim 0.095\,\text{GeV}\) (allowed)
- Up (\(u\)): \(\sim 0.002\,\text{GeV}\) (allowed)
- Down (\(d\)): \(\sim 0.005\,\text{GeV}\) (allowed)
- Tau (\(\tau\)): \(\sim 1.777\,\text{GeV}\) \(\Rightarrow 2m_\tau \approx 3.55\,\text{GeV} < 6\,\text{GeV}\) (allowed)
- Muon (\(\mu\)): \(\sim 0.105\,\text{GeV}\) (allowed)
- Electron (\(e\)): \(\sim 0.0005\,\text{GeV}\) (allowed)

The allowed final states are therefore \(c\bar{c}, s\bar{s}, u\bar{u}, d\bar{d}, \tau^+\tau^-, \mu^+\mu^-, e^+e^-\), which matches option (D).

Answer: D
